text: seow: "Top-decile rank and ret_63d 31.65 (C23)". Rank is Template criterion 8 only. Criterion 7 needs price within 25% of its 52-week high, and ASAN is 25.63% off it: all eight or none (C3). A former leader rebounding from that far down is the broken-leader caution (C13, R6) - the rebound is not yet a leader's base. What clears me: price back inside 25% of the high, with a base and a pivot cleared on volume. Then the rank you cite would carry it.
